title: Purair® BASIC Ductless Fume Hoods - Compact, Versatile Lab Equipment
meta_title: Purair BASIC Ductless Fume Hoods - Compact Lab Equipment for Hazardous Substances
meta_description: The Purair BASIC Series ductless fume hoods are compact, ideal for use in laboratory environments where space is limited or where only small volumes of harmful substances are handled.
meta_keywords: ductless fume hood, lab equipment, hazardous substances, compact, versatile, air science
short_description: The Purair® BASIC Series ductless fume hoods are compact, ideal for use in laboratory environments where space is limited or where only small volumes of harmful substances are handled. For package and mail inspection workstations, see Purair SafeSEARCH.
full_description: Using innovative filtration technology, the Purair Basic creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry. Features include high efficiency EC blower, energy saving LED lighting, filter blockage alarm, and a unique filter clamping design that eliminates bypass leakage outside the cabinet. The Purair Basic protects the operator from fume and (with added HEPA/ULPA filter) particle hazards.
seo_content: The Purair BASIC Series ductless fume hoods are compact, versatile lab equipment ideal for use in a variety of applications where space is limited or only small volumes of hazardous substances are handled. These energy-efficient, OSHA-compliant fume hoods utilize advanced filtration technology to create a safe work environment for applications ranging from forensics and histology to pharmaceutical and dental work.

Construction & Compliance.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood.

page_content_sections.overview: Using innovative filtration technology, the Purair Basic creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry.
page_content_sections.specifications: The Purair BASIC Series ductless fume hoods are constructed of epoxy-coated steel, comply with OSHA and ISO standards, and feature a unique filter clamping design that eliminates bypass leakage.
page_content_sections.applications: The Purair BASIC ductless fume hoods are ideal for use in a variety of laboratory environments, including compounding, forensics, pharmaceutical, and more.
page_content_sections.models: The Purair BASIC Series is available in 24", 36", and 48" widths, with both standard and shallow depth options.
